text:
oncall-bot: Pager: Dedicated pool 'resv-prod-2' reported 95% GPU util and queue growth > 500 for the last 10m. Priority: P1. @eric.sre oncall for SRE.
oncall-bot: Symptoms: autoscale attempted 3x in last 6m but hit max_instances=12, remaining requests are being throttled at queueing layer. Affected: several enterprise reservations (tenant: NovaBank) showing 100% reserved utilization.
eric.sre: I'm on it. checking metrics and recent deploys. Can someone confirm if any rollout touched serving-runtime in the last hour?
sophie.eng: Not from product side. Last runtime deploy was ~3h ago. No config changes to reserved pools.
aj-platform: I see a spike in short-running high-batch jobs from tenant 'analytics-sandbox' starting ~2105008700, might be noisy neighbor. They have non-reserved runs but landed on the same machines due to packing policy.
eric.sre: Good catch. Pulling logs from scheduler now. If autoscaler is at max we need to either increase max cap or evict/taint the noisy tenant.
maria-cs: Heads up — NovaBank on dedicated contract, they're already seeing 429s per their dashboard and emailed support. They're flagged as high-touch.
eric.sre: Agreed escalation path: 1) apply emergency rate-limit to analytics-sandbox to reduce new jobs, 2) migrate NovaBank reservations to spare-nodes pool, 3) request infra increase (cloud) for +4 GPUs. Performing (1) now.
eric.sre: Command used to throttle sandbox jobs: ```kubectl label namespace analytics-sandbox redwood/throttle=high --overwrite```
eric.sre: Applying migration plan for NovaBank: trying graceful drain from resv-prod-2 -> spare-resv-1 (will maintain reservation). Executing: ```redwoodctl migrate-reservation --tenant NOVABANK --from resv-prod-2 --to spare-resv-1 --grace-period 30s```
infra_lead: Spoke with cloud provider — capacity request for +4 A100s in region us-west-2 submitted, estimated 18-24min. Approving immediate emergency pool increase would incur extra cost.
sophie.eng: While we wait for cloud scale, we can temporarily change scheduling policy to avoid packing sandbox jobs onto reserved hosts. Pushing a host-affinity tweak now.
eric.sre: Migration succeeded for NovaBank (partial), 60% of their queued jobs moved, latency improving. Queue depth for NovaBank down from ~420 -> 90.
oncall-bot: Autoscaler: attempted scale at 2105008820, 2105008900, 2105008960 — hit max_instances on all attempts.
aj-platform: The noisy tenant rate-limit is reducing new submissions, but a backlog of short jobs still draining. If cloud add fails, plan B is to temporarily preempt low-priority background workloads across the pool (analytics-sandbox + batch-ingest). Need approval.
maria-cs: Approve Plan B for customer impact mitigation. Please prioritize NovaBank SLA. I'll notify their CSM and legal if needed.
eric.sre: Preemption executed: set priorityClass of batch-ingest to low and evicted ~78 pods. That bought ~3 GPUs equivalent. Observed immediate reduction in overall queue.
sophie.eng: After eviction + migration, observed token-serving latency for NovaBank reduced to near-SLO. Still seeing throttling for non-reserved tenants.
deploy-bot: Deploy complete: host-affinity patch rolled to 46/50 nodes.
infra_lead: Cloud report: +4 GPUs provisioned at 2105009000 — adding to pool. Once they join cluster we'll scale down eviction and restore normal packing.
eric.sre: Scaling group updated and new instances joined. Scaling autoscaler max_instances temporarily bumped to 18 to let nodes spin up.
oncall-bot: Incident note: impact window 2105008700 - 2105009000, primary cause: noisy tenant submission patterns combined with conservative autoscaler cap.
maria-cs: Notifying NovaBank with status update: "We mitigated the issue, your reserved workloads have been migrated and throttling minimized. We're adding capacity and doing follow-up remediation."
aj-platform: Follow-up tasks: 1) increase autoscaler emergency cap for resv pools to 20 (config PR), 2) add tenant isolation rule preventing non-reserved batch jobs from landing on reserved hosts (policy PR), 3) create a playbook step to proactively notify CSM when queue > 300 for reserved tenant.
eric.sre: Filing postmortem and follow-up issues. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
